name: ABSL_SMS_Control_Tower_agent
business: Ready Mix Concrete (RMC) - Akij Readymix Concrete Ltd (ARMCL)
framework: Akij Resource - Sales Management OS (Sales Digitalization & Performance Management initiative)
scope: Sales Management System (SMS) Control Tower for the ARMCL SBU: centralized view of targets, performance, pacing, planning, order book, drivers, territory/product/force breakdowns, coverage, exceptions, recovery, and KPIs

schemas.oms: order management (sales orders header/row, manpower targets)
schemas.mes: manufacturing execution / sales planning (sales plan header/row)

management_philosophy.diagnostic_loop: Find the Gap -> Diagnose the Cause -> Quantify the Opportunity -> Decide -> Assign -> Execute -> Verify -> Learn
management_philosophy.growth_model: Recover Existing Business -> Improve Productivity -> Expand Quality Growth -> Protect Margin, Cash & Inventory
management_philosophy.closed_loop: PLAN -> EXECUTE -> CONTROL -> ANALYZE -> RECOVER -> DELIVER -> LEARN -> REPLAN
management_philosophy.review_method: WHAT happened? WHY? SO WHAT? NOW WHAT? WHO? BY WHEN? DID IT WORK?

panels.purpose: Current month target, actual, achievement % and gap

queries.name: MTD Actual Sales (Net Value)
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(numNetOrderValue) AS mtd_sales, COUNT(*) AS mtd_orders FROM DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderHeaderArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND isActive=1 AND dteSalesOrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

queries.name: MTD Target (Manpower target)
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(numTargeAmount) AS mtd_target FROM DWH.oms.tblManpowerSalesTargetArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND isActive=1 AND intTargetYearId=(SELECT intId FROM DWH.pms.tblYearArc WHERE intYear = YEAR(GETDATE())) AND intTargetMonthId=MONTH(GETDATE())

queries.name: MTD Target (Target setup, fallback)
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(numTarget) AS mtd_target FROM DWH.pms.tblTargetSetupArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND isActive=1 AND strTargetFrequency='Monthly' AND strFrequencyValue = DATENAME(month, GETDATE()) + ', ' + CAST(YEAR(GETDATE()) AS varchar)

panels.panel: P2 - Daily / MTD / YTD Performance & Pacing
panels.purpose: Pacing vs required run rate (RDT / RADS)

kpis.Pace_RADS: Actual Run Rate / Required Run Rate
kpis.Projection: Run Rate x Total Working Days

queries.name: Daily Sales Trend (MTD by day)
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(dteSalesOrderDate AS date) AS sales_date, SUM(numNetOrderValue) AS daily_sales, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderHeaderArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND isActive=1 AND dteSalesOrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0) GROUP BY CAST(dteSalesOrderDate AS date) ORDER BY sales_date

queries.name: YTD Sales
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(numNetOrderValue) AS ytd_sales, COUNT(*) AS ytd_orders FROM DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderHeaderArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND isActive=1 AND dteSalesOrderDate >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),1,1)

queries.name: Month-over-Month Growth
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN dteSalesOrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month,0,GETDATE()),0) THEN numNetOrderValue END) AS cur_mtd, SUM(CASE WHEN dteSalesOrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month,0,GETDATE())-1,0) AND dteSalesOrderDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month,0,GETDATE()),0) THEN numNetOrderValue END) AS prev_mtd FROM DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderHeaderArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND isActive=1 AND dteSalesOrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month,0,GETDATE())-1,0)

panels.purpose: Sales plan (target) vs actual by month

queries.name: Monthly Sales Plan vs Order
queries.sql: SELECT MONTH(dteSalesOrderDate) AS plan_month, SUM(numNetOrderValue) AS actual FROM DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderHeaderArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND isActive=1 AND YEAR(dteSalesOrderDate)=YEAR(GETDATE()) GROUP BY MONTH(dteSalesOrderDate) ORDER BY plan_month

queries.name: Sales Plan (planned qty by item)
queries.sql: SELECT r.strItemName, SUM(r.numItemPlanQty) AS planned_qty FROM DWH.mes.tblSalesPlanRowArc r JOIN DWH.mes.tblSalesPlanHeaderArc h ON r.intSalesPlanId=h.intSalesPlanId WHERE h.intBusinessUnitId=175 AND r.isActive=1 GROUP BY r.strItemName ORDER BY planned_qty DESC

panels.purpose: Open orders, undelivered quantity/value, delivery (lifting) progress

queries.name: Open / Undelivered Order Book
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(r.numUndeliveryValues) AS open_order_value, SUM(r.numUndeliveryQuantity) AS open_order_qty FROM DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderRowArc r JOIN DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderHeaderArc h ON r.intSalesOrderId=h.intSalesOrderId WHERE r.intBusinessUnitId=175 AND h.isActive=1 AND h.isApproved=1 AND h.isCompleted=0 AND h.isRejected=0

queries.name: Lifting Progress (Delivery by month)
queries.sql: SELECT MONTH(dteDeliveryDate) AS lift_month, SUM(numTotalDeliveryQuantity) AS delivered_qty, SUM(numTotalNetValue) AS delivered_value FROM DWH.sms.tblDeliveryHeaderArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND YEAR(dteDeliveryDate)=YEAR(GETDATE()) GROUP BY MONTH(dteDeliveryDate) ORDER BY lift_month

panels.purpose: Decompose sales into drivers (Growth Tree): Active customers x Frequency x Order Value; demand by concrete grade
panels.kpi: Sales Growth Tree = Active x Frequency x Average Order Value

queries.name: Active Customers, Frequency, AOV (MTD)
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT intSoldToPartnerId) AS active_customers, COUNT(*) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT intSoldToPartnerId),0) AS avg_frequency, SUM(numNetOrderValue) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS avg_order_value FROM DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderHeaderArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND isActive=1 AND dteSalesOrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month,0,GETDATE()),0)

queries.name: Product (Grade) Mix MTD
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 15 r.strItemName, SUM(r.numOrderQuantity) AS qty, SUM(r.numNetValue) AS value FROM DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderRowArc r JOIN DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderHeaderArc h ON r.intSalesOrderId=h.intSalesOrderId WHERE r.intBusinessUnitId=175 AND h.isActive=1 AND h.dteSalesOrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month,0,GETDATE()),0) GROUP BY r.strItemName ORDER BY value DESC

panels.guardrail: AOV or Frequency declining vs prior month = AMBER

panels.purpose: Sales by territory, plant, and sales office

queries.name: Sales by Plant (MTD)
queries.sql: SELECT strPlantName, SUM(numNetOrderValue) AS net_value, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderHeaderArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND isActive=1 AND dteSalesOrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month,0,GETDATE()),0) GROUP BY strPlantName ORDER BY net_value DESC

queries.name: Sales by Sales Office (MTD)
queries.sql: SELECT strSalesOfficeName, SUM(numNetOrderValue) AS net_value, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderHeaderArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND isActive=1 AND dteSalesOrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month,0,GETDATE()),0) GROUP BY strSalesOfficeName ORDER BY net_value DESC

queries.name: Territory Coverage (salesforce-territory map)
queries.sql: SELECT strTerritoryName, COUNT(*) AS force_count FROM DWH.oms.tblSalesForceTerritoryArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 GROUP BY strTerritoryName ORDER BY force_count DESC

panels.guardrail: Any plant < 70% of its monthly share baseline = AMBER

panels.purpose: Concrete grade (PSI) performance: volume, value, mix share, margin proxy

queries.name: Grade-wise MTD (Volume & Value)
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 20 r.strItemName, SUM(r.numOrderQuantity) AS qty, SUM(r.numNetValue) AS value FROM DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderRowArc r JOIN DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderHeaderArc h ON r.intSalesOrderId=h.intSalesOrderId WHERE r.intBusinessUnitId=175 AND h.isActive=1 AND h.dteSalesOrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month,0,GETDATE()),0) GROUP BY r.strItemName ORDER BY qty DESC

queries.name: Grade Mix Share
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 20 r.strItemName, SUM(r.numOrderQuantity) AS qty, ROUND(100.0*SUM(r.numOrderQuantity)/NULLIF(SUM(SUM(r.numOrderQuantity)) OVER (),0),1) AS mix_share FROM DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderRowArc r JOIN DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderHeaderArc h ON r.intSalesOrderId=h.intSalesOrderId WHERE r.intBusinessUnitId=175 AND h.isActive=1 AND h.dteSalesOrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month,0,GETDATE()),0) GROUP BY r.strItemName ORDER BY qty DESC

panels.guardrail: A grade with > 10% qty share and price below base matrix = AMBER

panels.purpose: Orders and value per salesperson; coverage of assigned territories
panels.kpi: Orders/rep, Value/rep, Target Achievement per rep

queries.name: Salesperson Productivity (MTD)
queries.sql: SELECT strSalesForceEmpName, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(numNetOrderValue) AS value FROM DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderHeaderArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND isActive=1 AND dteSalesOrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month,0,GETDATE()),0) AND strSalesForceEmpName IS NOT NULL AND strSalesForceEmpName <> '' GROUP BY strSalesForceEmpName ORDER BY value DESC

queries.name: Rep Target Achievement (Manpower target)
queries.sql: SELECT intEmployeeEnroll, SUM(numTargeAmount) AS target_amt, SUM(numTargeQnt) AS target_qty FROM DWH.oms.tblManpowerSalesTargetArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND isActive=1 AND intTargetMonthId=MONTH(GETDATE()) AND intTargetYearId=(SELECT intId FROM DWH.pms.tblYearArc WHERE intYear=YEAR(GETDATE())) GROUP BY intEmployeeEnroll ORDER BY target_amt DESC

panels.guardrail: Rep with 0 orders for 5+ working days = RED (inactive)

panels.purpose: Customer universe, active customers, coverage % by territory

queries.name: Customer Universe & Active (MTD)
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DWH.prt.tblBusinessPartnerArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND isActive=1) AS customer_universe, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT intSoldToPartnerId) FROM DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderHeaderArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND isActive=1 AND dteSalesOrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month,0,GETDATE()),0)) AS active_customers

queries.name: Customer Type Mix
queries.sql: SELECT strPartnerSalesType, COUNT(*) AS n FROM DWH.prt.tblBusinessPartnerArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 GROUP BY strPartnerSalesType ORDER BY n DESC

panels.guardrail: Coverage < 30% of universe transacting in a month = AMBER

panels.purpose: Flag RED/AMBER gaps across guardrails; list offending territories, products, reps
panels.kpi: RAG status per guardrail: SALES | MARGIN | CASH | CREDIT | STOCK | SERVICE | GOVERNANCE | DATA

queries.name: Overdue Customers (credit guardrail)
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 20 strSoldToPartnerName, SUM(numTotalNetValue) AS delivered_value FROM DWH.sms.tblDeliveryHeaderArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND dteDeliveryDate < DATEADD(day, -60, GETDATE()) AND isCommercialInvoice=1 GROUP BY strSoldToPartnerName ORDER BY delivered_value DESC

queries.name: Zero-Order Customers (MTD)
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 20 p.strBusinessPartnerName FROM DWH.prt.tblBusinessPartnerArc p WHERE p.intBusinessUnitId=175 AND p.isActive=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DWH.oms.tblSalesOrderHeaderArc o WHERE o.intSoldToPartnerId=p.intBusinessPartnerId AND o.intBusinessUnitId=175 AND o.dteSalesOrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month,0,GETDATE()),0))

panels.guardrail: A business is not fully GREEN when a critical guardrail is RED

panels.purpose: Track collection recovery and action plans against gaps
panels.kpi: Collection % , Credit release, Action effectiveness = Actual Impact / Expected Impact

queries.name: Collection vs Delivery (MTD)
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(numTotalNetValue) AS delivered_value, SUM(numPaymentAmount) AS collected, ROUND(100.0*SUM(numPaymentAmount)/NULLIF(SUM(numTotalNetValue),0),1) AS collection_pct FROM DWH.sms.tblDeliveryHeaderArc WHERE intBusinessUnitId=175 AND dteDeliveryDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month,0,GETDATE()),0)

panels.purpose: Roll-up KPI scorecard with RAG, alerts, and narrative insights
panels.kpi: Scorecard: Achievement %, Growth %, DSO, Overdue %, Coverage %, Strike Rate, Lifting %, Collection %

queries.name: KPI Register (relevant KPIs)
queries.sql: SELECT intKPIsId, strCode, strKPIs FROM DWH.pms.tblKPIsArc WHERE strKPIs LIKE '%sales%' OR strKPIs LIKE '%collect%' OR strKPIs LIKE '%target%' OR strKPIs LIKE '%outstanding%' OR strKPIs LIKE '%conversion%' OR strKPIs LIKE '%growth%'

panels.guardrail: Generate RED list with owner + target date + follow-up (Recovery Plan)

pace_rads.formula: Actual Run Rate / Required Run Rate

projection.formula: Run Rate x Total Working Days

available_credit.formula: Credit Limit - Outstanding - Open Orders - Unbilled

sales_growth_tree.formula: Active x Frequency x Average Order Value

rag_guardrails.rule: A business is not fully GREEN when a critical guardrail is RED

daily_control.focus: RDT, pace, visits, zero-orders, stock-out, collection, approvals

weekly_review.focus: Gap, opportunity, distribution, productivity, execution, credit, stock

monthly_business_review.focus: Scorecard, bridge, forecast, margin, partner health, working capital, people, actions

quarterly_strategic_review.focus: Market, demand, RTM, territory design, channel economics, capability, investments

gaps.detail: Policy/SOP documents live in private Google Docs
gaps.impact: Cannot read policy content through MCP

gaps.detail: PolicyHeaderArc = 0 ARMCL rows; empSOPArc = 0 ARMCL rows
Live credit hold, customer statements in iBOS web (login-gated)
gaps.impact: Available Credit / Credit Utilisation cannot be computed live
P8 productivity limited to few reps; needs sales-force mapping

gaps.detail: No DWH table; lives in Drive
gaps.impact: Demand driver external inputs not queryable

notes: Target data (tblTargetSetupArc) has many rows with numTarget=0; use tblManpowerSalesTargetArc (numTargeAmount) as primary MTD target source where populated
Delivery (sms.tblDeliveryHeaderArc) has numTotalDeliveryQuantity / numTotalNetValue / numPaymentAmount - use for lifting and collection panels
Sales plan lives in mes schema (tblSalesPlanHeaderArc / tblSalesPlanRowArc); numItemPlanQty is the planned quantity
